speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Osgood-Schlatter disease. The physical exam findings of tenderness over the medial tibial tubercle in an obese patient, combined with the denial of acute injury or swelling, strongly support this diagnosis of traction apophysitis. While Osgood-Schlatter typically presents in adolescents, the clinical picture is consistent with repetitive strain on the tibial tubercle.
